text:
Platinum Price in 2026
Among 9 monthly observations available for 2026, the LBMA platinum price fell 23.1% between 2026-01-30 ($2,300) and 2026-09-25 ($1,769). The highest sampled price was $2,366 in February and the lowest was $1,567 in June. The mean of these observations was $1,923. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
